notes: Panel proportions, worked out against the real layout in an emulator. The bedroom roller shutter becomes a tall narrow tile - one unit wide, full height - which is the shape its vertical travel actually wants. The curtain keeps its short wide window a size narrower, and pairs with the dining light. Both lights go half height: a light carries a name, a warmth row and a brightness bar, and on a full-height tile that was a third of the panel for three lines - the warmth dots now ride in the head row, where the width was going spare. A covering states its position in its own head, so it still reads when the control drops its caption on a short or narrow tile.
